allowed: deterministic nuisance and synthetic controls derived from clean-only inputs
forbidden: R4d DS3 scores as a BITPROBE design input

edge_contract.boundary_coordinate: absolute raw complex-sample coordinate from R0c corrected_raw_start_sample
edge_contract.candidate_rule: For every target PRN, use consecutive R0c corrected bits whose boundary lies wholly within the R0c authorized common interval, corrected_confidence equals 1, phase_extrapolation_match is true, source_method and boundary_basis match R0c, and inherited parity/preamble/TOW checks pass.
edge_contract.direction_canonicalization: Multiply the despread edge by previous bit_value_pm1 so flip edges are +1 to -1 and no-flip controls are +1 to +1.

fractional_alignment.interpolation: complex linear interpolation on signed receiver sample coordinates after carrier wipe-off and code despreading

edge_contract.ideal_and_control_removal: Fit one complex amplitude to the canonical ideal sign template using samples outside +/-0.25 chip, divide by that amplitude, subtract the ideal template, then subtract the robust same-PRN no-flip residual kernel from the flip residual kernel.
edge_contract.normalization: Per-edge complex least-squares amplitude and global-phase normalization; magnitude-only features are prohibited.
edge_contract.robust_aggregation: coordinate-wise median of real and imaginary residuals followed by L2 normalization only for similarity calculations

edge_exclusion_contract.agc_outlier: absolute robust z-score above 6 for log fitted-amplitude magnitude within PRN using flip and no-flip candidates jointly
edge_exclusion_contract.alignment: exclude when delay-center consistency exceeds 0.125 chip, Doppler-center consistency exceeds 50 Hz, fractional offset exceeds 0.5 sample, or interpolation reconstruction error exceeds 1e-6 sample
edge_exclusion_contract.clipping: exclude if any raw I or Q component in the frozen window has absolute value 32767 or greater
edge_exclusion_contract.mapping: exclude parity/bit/phase provenance failure, nonconsecutive bit indices, corrected boundary discontinuity, or boundary outside the authorized R0c common interval
edge_exclusion_contract.overlap: exclude both candidates if their +/-4 chip raw windows overlap
edge_exclusion_contract.raw_bounds: exclude when the complete +/-4 chip window is unavailable
edge_exclusion_contract.tracking: require valid_tracking=1, valid_lock=1, C/N0>=28 dB-Hz, carrier_lock_test>=0.85, unchanged PRN/session, and valid preceding/current TRACE records
edge_exclusion_contract.zero_fill: exclude if complex-zero fraction exceeds 0.10 or a consecutive complex-zero run reaches 8 samples

model_contract.feature: deterministic complex NAV-edge residual kernels and preregistered cross-PRN operator statistics

provenance_contract.R0c_scope: only the two approximately 12-second authorized common intervals; no distant extrapolation

scientific_limitation.statement: A common linear response observed by one receiver cannot identify whether the operator is transmitter-side or receiver-front-end. Receiver-side and transmitter-side nonlinearities may also remain nonlocalizable; that limitation must be reported.

split_and_inference.bootstrap_unit: contiguous blocks of 10 NAV edges within PRN; never waveform samples
split_and_inference.primary_split: chronological first and second halves independently within PRN and edge class
split_and_inference.prn_permutation: exact permutation of second-half PRN kernel labels within each dataset

synthetic_contract.null_threshold: 95th percentile of calibration-seed null scores, evaluated only on disjoint evaluation seeds
synthetic_contract.operator_statistic: median absolute cross-PRN third-order residual plus leading common-subspace fraction of edge-conditioned Volterra residuals
synthetic_contract.receiver_linear_confound: must not be interpreted as transmitter evidence
synthetic_contract.receiver_nonlinear_confound: report source_localization_unavailable when indistinguishable from transmitter common nonlinearity
scenarios: separate-emitter per-PRN weak LTI/PA before summation

target_prn_rule.rule: Use every PRN in the R0c authorized common interval whose tracking_continuity status is PASS and whose corrected mapping has complete validated bit/phase provenance; do not select by edge outcome or metric.

verdict_contract.identifiable: Both clean datasets pass gates 1-6, synthetic gate passes, confound limitation is recorded, and forbidden access is zero.
verdict_contract.inconclusive: Any execution, provenance, raw binding, mapping, alignment, resource, or minimum-support failure.
verdict_contract.not_identifiable: Both datasets are technically complete but the frozen scientific gates or synthetic gate fail.
verdict_contract.partial: Both datasets are technically complete and exactly one dataset passes all real-data gates 1-6.
